QuestInfo.name: Snap Out of It!
QuestInfo.1: You got the item to offer the queen to get Jasmin's son a job but you don't know if is the right thing to do. You understand where Jasmin is coming from but you still do not feel right about it. Go find Jasmin's son, #bAldin#k and explain the situation
QuestInfo.2: You explain the situation to Aldin about the bribe and Aldin states that he will not worry his mother anymore. He also states that instead of  the item being used as a bribe he will use it to start a new business.

1.0: What business do you have with me?
1.1: ...I can't believe it. Mother didn't tell me anything. I've been such a jerk to my parents...

yes.0: Thank you, my friends, for talking some sense into me. I cannot let my mother worry so. Give me those items. I will use them to start a business!

npc.0: I would do anything for Aldin. My dear, sweet boy.
